name: Hush Over-Ear Headphones
description: Soft memory-foam cushions, a closed back that keeps the train out, and a battery that lasts a working week. Folds flat into its own pouch.

name: Crimson Mechanical Keyboard
description: A compact mechanical board with tactile switches that click without waking the house. Double-shot caps in a deep red that will not wear shiny.

name: Slate Shelf Speaker
description: A plain white box that sounds far bigger than it looks. Pair two for stereo, or leave one in the kitchen and forget it is there.

name: Orbit Smartwatch
description: A round, always-on display with the things you actually check: time, steps, weather and who is calling. Charges once a week.

name: Relic Folding Camera
description: A restored mid-century folding camera with working bellows and shutter. Shoots 120 film, and looks just as good on a shelf between rolls.
specs: Only a few restored each month

name: Canal City Bicycle
description: An upright city bike in teal with a wicker basket, a three-speed hub and mudguards. Built for flat streets, bakeries and not being in a hurry.

name: Trailhead Canvas Backpack
description: Waxed canvas that shrugs off rain, leather straps that soften with age, and a padded sleeve for a 15-inch laptop when the trail is the commute.

name: Dash Street Sneakers
description: Washed canvas on a springy rubber sole, in a pink-red you can see from across the street. Runs true to size.

name: Lemon Drop Sunglasses
description: Sunshine-yellow frames with proper UV400 lenses. Cheap enough to sit on, good enough to keep.

name: Kerb Cruiser Skateboard
description: A seven-ply maple cruiser with soft wheels that roll over rough pavement. Comes fully assembled and ready to push.

name: Indigo Cast-Iron Teapot
blurb: Keeps tea hot for an hour.
description: A heavy cast-iron pot in deep indigo with an enamelled inside and a steel infuser basket. Holds heat long after the kettle has cooled.

name: Poppy Cappuccino Cup
description: A thick-walled stoneware cup in poppy red with a matching saucer. The right size for a flat white, a cappuccino or an ambitious espresso.

name: Ember Enamel Camp Mug
description: Enamel over steel, the way camp mugs have always been made. Sits on a fire grate, survives being dropped, and chips with character.

name: Tealight Pair
description: A pair of soy-wax tealights in glass cups. Around six hours each, no scent, just a warm corner.

name: Spider Plant in Ceramic Pot
blurb: Hard to kill. Good in any room.
description: The plant for people who forget plants. Arrives potted in a white ceramic planter and forgives a missed week of watering.

name: Succulent Trio
description: Three small succulents chosen to look good together. They want a bright windowsill and to be mostly left alone.

name: Wayfarer Notebook
description: A stitched notebook that opens flat, with 160 dotted pages thick enough for a fountain pen and a ribbon to mark your place.

name: Fireside Wingback Armchair
description: A vintage wingback, rebuilt and reupholstered in a soft tan fabric. Deep seat, high back, and wings for leaning into with a book.
